mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversations ( user_id, title, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, last_message_at, created_at FROM chat_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, created_at) DESC, conversation_id DESC

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, last_message_at, created_at FROM chat_conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, last_message_at, created_at FROM chat_conversations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC, conversation_id DESC

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, status, last_message_at, created_at FROM chat_conversations WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversations SET title = COALESCE(#{title}, title), last_message_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE chat_conversations SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE chat_conversations SET status = 'ACTIVE', deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
